name: super-meat-boy-again-plus-announced-november-14
lines:
أعلنت تيم ميت (Team Meat)
عن نسخة Again Plus

اللعبة قادمة إلى Steam
والموعد لم يُعلن بعد
headline:
عودة Super Meat Boy
مع كل شيء جديد
label: رسمي

angle.hook: Team Meat announced Super Meat Boy Again+, the 2010 platformer rebuilt with new art, music and cutscenes, on Steam
angle.why_now: the announcement and Steam page went up on 14 Nov 2026 (Gematsu 04:36Z); no release date yet
angle.what_it_means_here: PC players on Steam can wishlist it; Steam lists no Arabic among its languages and no price or date yet
angle.payoff: over 300 levels and a new soundtrack by the original composer, release date to be announced

tried: Steam Announcement Trailer (movie 257505532, 1080p60, 69.6 s): mostly black text cards (HEY / remember that game / AGAIN), tiny top-down level views whose subject cannot be framed in 9:16, blood-splattered replay and fire stretches

bed_reason: Stills Reel on official Steam screenshots, which have no sound; the only official trailer opened (Steam Announcement Trailer, movie 257505532) is black text cards, tiny top-down levels and blood-splattered stretches, so our bed plays under the stills and the jingle on the end card.

reel_check.SOURCE: primary read in full: yes: Team Meat's Steam page (appdetails 4269060 and the store page) read 14 Nov ~12:40Z; Gematsu and Denfaminico read for context
reel_check.SOURCE: not already posted: yes: grep of newsroom/stories for 'meat boy' finds only this story
reel_check.SOURCE: age: yes: first report 14 Nov 04:36Z (Gematsu), under 24 h at 09:15 Dubai 15 Nov is about 28 h; no Arabic outlet carries it, so still news (24 to 48 h rule)
reel_check.STORY TYPE announcement: yes: what it is, platform (Steam), what is new, 300+ levels, date to be announced, no price listed
reel_check.STORY: spoken paragraph, subject before: yes: headline names Super Meat Boy; L1 Team Meat announces Again Plus; L2 art, music, scenes; L3 300+ levels; L4 coming to Steam, date not announced
reel_check.STORY: release verbs: yes: قادمة إلى Steam, الموعد لم يُعلن بعد; no bare تصل
reel_check.POST: Arabic passes: yes: arabic-games-film-editor, arabic-writing, arabic-grammar-review (separate pass: line 1 needed عن after أعلنت, applied), DeepL forward whole story and back-check; Western digits; plus sign spelled out (Again Plus)
reel_check.SOUND: footage sound or bed with reason: bed: stills have no sound; bed_reason names the one trailer opened
reel_check.PICTURE: not the same as last 5 reels: yes: no recent Reel on Super Meat Boy
reel_check.CREDIT: on every clip: yes: credit from frame 0 over every shot
